* Vendored Android C cross-compilation support (#462)

This is an unmodified subset of Android NDK r30, package revision
30.0.16248370, installed with Google's SDK Manager. The source toolchain
is ~toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/~; its clang reports version 21
and LLVM revision ~9f872551d3c681d06fd303b36f16ed5c274735eb~.
The NDK is needed to extract/update or cross-check this subset, not to
build a til program against it.

** Contents

  - ~sysroot/usr/include/~: bionic, Linux UAPI and Android C headers,
    including the ~aarch64-linux-android/~ and ~x86_64-linux-android/~
    architecture headers. Excludes libc++ headers and other architectures.
  - ~sysroot/usr/lib/<triple>/28/~: the upstream ~libc.so~, ~libm.so~,
    ~libdl.so~ and ~liblog.so~ linker stubs, plus ~crtbegin_dynamic.o~,
    ~crtbegin_so.o~, ~crtend_android.o~ and ~crtend_so.o~. The stubs describe
    the minimum API 28 interface; Android supplies the real libraries at
    runtime. Do not package these stubs into an APK or copy them to a device.
  - ~lib/~: upstream ~libclang_rt.builtins-aarch64-android.a~ and
    ~libclang_rt.builtins-x86_64-android.a~, from
    ~lib/clang/21/lib/linux/~ in that toolchain.
  - ~NOTICE~ and ~NOTICE.toolchain~: upstream aggregate notices, copied
    verbatim. Headers retain their per-file notices. These cover bionic
    and Linux UAPI licensing and compiler-rt's Apache-2.0 with LLVM
    exception, among the NDK's other components.

The initial subset has about 13.3 MB apparent size (17 MiB allocated on
the extraction filesystem), including notices. The full NDK C/C++ include
tree alone occupied 32 MiB; excluded C++ headers accounted for 17 MiB.
No libc++, libffi, sanitizer runtime, unwinder or host compiler binary is
included. C programs tested here do not require a separate unwinder.

** Building

From the til checkout, with host ~clang~ and ~ld.lld~ available:

#+begin_src sh
bin/til build --target=android-x64 examples/hello_script.til
bin/til build --target=android-arm64 examples/hello_script.til
#+end_src

~src/self/targets.til~ selects the Android API 28 triple and this sysroot,
including the selected architecture's headers and API-level library path.
The link uses LLD, the explicit compiler-rt archive, libc/dl/m, and
16 KB maximum page alignment. ~-nodefaultlibs~ prevents the host clang
driver from injecting host libgcc or looking for an Android compiler-rt
under its own resource directory. The host clang still uses its own
builtin headers (stddef, stdarg, intrinsics); they are compiler-specific.
The initial host check used clang/LLD 18.1.3.
Executable freshness checks track the selected vendored headers, startup
objects, linker stubs and builtins archive, so upgrading them invalidates
an existing output.

Both targets support the existing ~--usize=32~ and ~--usize=64~ layouts.
The subset is optional: the default build and test suite do not need the
Android SDK, NDK, ADB or emulator. Running the resulting executable needs
an Android device/emulator; ~til run~ does not launch an emulator.
NativeActivity/APK and Android JNI packaging remain separate #462 work.

** Extraction and upgrades

Use a fresh destination for an upgrade so files removed upstream do not
remain accidentally. The commands below describe the initial selection;
~NDK~ and ~TOOLCHAIN~ are local shell variables, not til configuration.
Preserve the source bytes and notices, record the new package/compiler
revisions above, measure the result, and repeat the NDK comparison and
device checks described in #462 before committing an upgrade.

#+begin_src sh
NDK="$HOME/Android/Sdk/ndk/30.0.16248370"
TOOLCHAIN="$NDK/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64"
mkdir -p vendor/android/sysroot/usr/include vendor/android/lib
tar -C "$TOOLCHAIN/sysroot/usr/include" \
    --exclude=./c++ --exclude=./arm-linux-androideabi \
    --exclude=./i686-linux-android --exclude=./riscv64-linux-android \
    -cf - . | tar -C vendor/android/sysroot/usr/include -xf -
for triple in aarch64-linux-android x86_64-linux-android; do
    mkdir -p "vendor/android/sysroot/usr/lib/$triple/28"
    for file in libc.so libm.so libdl.so liblog.so crtbegin_dynamic.o crtbegin_so.o crtend_android.o crtend_so.o; do
        cp -a "$TOOLCHAIN/sysroot/usr/lib/$triple/28/$file" \
            "vendor/android/sysroot/usr/lib/$triple/28/"
    done
done
cp -a "$TOOLCHAIN/lib/clang/21/lib/linux/libclang_rt.builtins-aarch64-android.a" \
    "$TOOLCHAIN/lib/clang/21/lib/linux/libclang_rt.builtins-x86_64-android.a" vendor/android/lib/
cp -a "$NDK/NOTICE" "$NDK/NOTICE.toolchain" vendor/android/
#+end_src
